title: Tummy Tuck Recovery Time: Week by Week, Mini vs Full
meta_description: You can walk the same day, often work in about 2 weeks and begin to feel more normal around 8 weeks. A tummy tuck recovery timeline, mini to extended.
excerpt: How long tummy tuck recovery takes, week by week: walking, work, driving, lifting your kids, sleep and the scar. What changes after a mini, full or extended tummy tuck, and the signs that mean you should call your surgeon.
quick_answer:
How long does it take to recover from a tummy tuck?

You can walk the day of surgery, often work in about 2 weeks and wait 6 weeks for running and lifting (Cindy Wu, MD, on the ASPS website). ASPS says you should stand tall within a week or two. Full recovery takes around 3 months; after a mini, most work again in 1 to 2 weeks (Samir Rao, MD).

Tummy tuck recovery, week by week

Day of surgery: walk, and have someone stay the first night
7 to 10 days: bent at the waist, then standing straight
About 2 weeks: back to work for many people
4 to 6 weeks: compression garment comes off
6 weeks: running and lifting, if your surgeon agrees
Around 8 weeks: most people begin to feel more normal
About 3 months: most swelling gone, healing can continue up to a year
12 to 18 months: scar thinner and lighter

Sources: Wu, Salemy, Rao and Vitenas on the ASPS website; ASPS

sources.title: Answers to common tummy tuck questions
quotes: You will be bent at the waist while standing or lying down for 7-10 days after surgery to protect the incision and to allow for your skin to adapt.
After surgery, you will be placed in a compression garment, which will be worn for 4-6 weeks after surgery to help with reducing swelling.
most patients are able to manage post-procedure pain or discomfort with just a few days of pain medications.
If a drain is placed, then it will be removed as soon as the output is low enough (usually in 1-2 weeks).

You can walk the day of surgery. In fact, most plastic surgeons encourage patients to walk three times the day of surgery to improve blood circulation to keep the risk of blood clots in the legs to a minimum. However, running or lifting should be avoided for six weeks after the procedure.

Patients typically return to work in approximately two weeks. The bruising will subside in a couple of weeks, and the swelling will continue to diminish until approximately three months post-procedure. The scars will continue to heal and will become thinner and lighter in color at around 12-18 months.
With stable weight, tummy tuck results are stable over time. If you experience any weight fluctuations or become pregnant, this may change your tummy tuck result.
The views expressed in this blog are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the American Society of Plastic Surgeons.
